The poor orphan niece (Deanna Durbin) of a tycoon (Eugene Pallette) goes to a ball and meets a rich boyfriend (Robert Stack).
programme.title: First Love

programme.desc: A woman (Millie Perkins), two bounty hunters and a gunman (Jack Nicholson) ride into a desert and run out of water.
programme.title: The Shooting

programme.desc: A traveling salesman (Edmond O'Brien) with a wife (Joan Fontaine) in San Francisco marries a waitress (Ida Lupino) in Los Angeles.
programme.title: The Bigamist

programme.desc: The jazz trombonist (James Stewart) marries his sweetheart (June Allyson), forms a band and creates his signature sound.
programme.title: The Glenn Miller Story

programme.desc: A poor but hopeful boy seeks one of the five coveted golden tickets that will send him on a tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious chocolate factory.
programme.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory

programme.desc: One U.S. soldier (Paul Douglas) warns another (Montgomery Clift) about the latter's German girlfriend (Cornell Borchers) during the Berlin airlift.
programme.title: The Big Lift

programme.desc: An English girl's dream of racing her horse in the Grand National thunders to reality with the help of a former jockey.
programme.title: National Velvet

programme.desc: Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the Enterprise crew battle an old foe (Ricardo Montalban) who blames Kirk for the death of his wife.
programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan

programme.desc: A bachelor (Jerry Lewis) agrees to baby-sit for a Hollywood star (Marilyn Maxwell), who turns out to have triplets.
programme.title: Rock-a-Bye Baby

programme.desc: The girl (Glynnis O'Connor) next door makes a teen (John Travolta) born with immune deficiencies want to leave his germ-free bubble.
programme.title: The Boy in the Plastic Bubble

programme.desc: Josephine Marcus (Marie Osmond) falls for the marshal (Bruce Boxleitner) of Tombstone, Ariz., while touring with an opera company.
programme.title: I Married Wyatt Earp

programme.desc: Illinois lawyer Abraham Lincoln (Henry Fonda) becomes known for his honesty and solves a murder with a courtroom trick.
programme.title: Young Mr. Lincoln

programme.desc: A bounty hunter (Glenn Ford) faces his son's killers with help from the son (Michael Burns) of an outlaw he has killed.
programme.title: Santee

programme.desc: Seven children undertake the hazardous 2000-mile journey from Missouri to Oregon in the 1840s after their parents' death.
programme.title: Seven Alone

programme.desc: Stan and Ollie rescue Bo-Peep, Tom-Tom and other Mother Goose characters from Toyland miser Barnaby.
programme.title: March of the Wooden Soldiers

programme.desc: A beauty contestant (Paulette Goddard) fills in for a fortuneteller and changes a lawyer's (Ray Milland) future with a rich widow (Virginia Field).
programme.title: The Crystal Ball

programme.desc: Lt. Col. James Doolittle (Spencer Tracy) leads B-25s off the USS Hornet's deck on a 1942 mission to bomb Japan.
programme.title: Thirty Seconds Over Tokyo

programme.desc: A blind private eye (Edward Arnold) with a guide dog probes a murder for a friend (Ann Harding) and finds a Nazi spy ring.
programme.title: Eyes in the Night

programme.desc: A woman (Lizabeth Scott) kills her husband and plots with a private eye (Dan Duryea) after someone tosses a moneybag into her car.
programme.title: Too Late for Tears

programme.desc: Private eye Mike Hammer (Mickey Spillane) asks a bikinied blonde (Shirley Eaton) and others about his long-lost secretary, Velda.
programme.title: The Girl Hunters

programme.desc: Capt. Jones (Anthony Hopkins), William Brewster (Richard Crenna), Priscilla Mullins (Jenny Agutter) and company have a rough trip on the Mayflower.
programme.title: Mayflower: The Pilgrims' Adventure

programme.desc: A selfish San Franciscan (Mona Freeman) loses a husband (June Duprez) in the war and marries a reformed racketeer (James Dunn).
programme.title: That Brennan Girl

programme.desc: A U.S. Cavalry officer (Audie Murphy) falls in love with a part-Indian missionary (Linda Lawson) in Arizona.
programme.title: Apache Rifles

programme.desc: A swimming instructor (Ann-Margret) detours a singing auto racer (Elvis Presley) in town for the Grand Prix.
programme.title: Viva Las Vegas

programme.desc: A teenager (Tuesday Weld) wants to wear a strapless gown to the prom.
programme.title: Rock, Rock, Rock!

programme.desc: A minor-league pitcher (Richard Pryor) inherits $300 million but must spend $30 million in 30 days to get it.
programme.title: Brewster's Millions

programme.desc: The mythical Greek hero (Reg Park) rescues a maiden left at the mercy of a beast and goes on to save his son from the sexist queen of lost Atlantis (Fay Spain).
programme.title: Hercules and the Captive Women

programme.desc: Two guys (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) and a girl (Melody Anderson) brave jungle hazards to find an Aztec temple filled with gold.
programme.title: Firewalker

programme.desc: The Wolf Man tries to warn a dim-witted porter that Dracula wants his brain for a monster's body.
programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein

programme.desc: S01 E08 — The Quiz Show Feeling like a failure because he hasn't done anything famous to make Alexander proud, Dagwood applies to compete in a nationwide quiz show.
programme.title: Blondie

programme.desc: S05 E12 — Lucy and Mooney the Monkey Lucy goes to a psychiatrist after seeing a monkey everywhere she goes.
programme.title: The Lucy Show

programme.desc: Spouses (Irene Dunne, Cary Grant) try to spoil each other's chances for romance before their divorce becomes final in 90 days.
programme.title: The Awful Truth

programme.desc: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.
programme.title: McLintock!

programme.desc: A 110-year-old former Louisiana slave (Cicely Tyson) reminisces about her life and society from the Civil War to germinating civil rights.
programme.title: The Autobiography of Miss Jane Pittman

programme.desc: A poor street cleaner is relentlessly bullied by the people of a small western township, but things change when a ruthless gunfighter rides into the town.
programme.title: Day of Anger

programme.desc: An advice-to-the-lovelorn writer (Bob Hope) falls for the only single girl (Lana Turner) in a town full of women.
programme.title: Bachelor in Paradise
